personas.name: Unsatisifed subscriber.
personas.description: A user who experienced unexpected charges due to shady business tactics following the end of a free trial.
goals: Get proper refund after cancelling a subscription.
context: Automatically subscribed after the free trial despite cancelling.
Contacted support team following unwatned subscription charge.
constraints: Lock into a subscription must be explicit.
Support team must be forgiving in terms of refunds for wrongful subscriptions.

personas.name: Poor Sleepers.
personas.description: Users who have problems with sleeping.
goals: Fall asleep faster using Calm's voices/audio.
Have a large variety of sleep stories/audio to select from.
pain_points: Voices are somewhat limited in terms of variety.
Lack of environmental audio for relaxtion.
context: App is a part of nightly routine where sleep quality has improved as a result.
Finds environmental/nature sounds relaxing and would like to fall asleep to them.
constraints: Audio/voice library variety must not be limited to a few voices/sounds.
App must not crash during night when asleep.

personas.name: Middle Class Customer
personas.description: Regular customer who enjoys apps services but thinks the pricing is unreasonably expensive.
goals: Access to mental wellness tools at reasonable prices.
Advocating for accessibility of mental health resources.
pain_points: Pricing makes mental health tools inaccessible.
context: Cost of subscription is no longer justified by the services provided by app.
Lack of consideration for people who are not as finnicially well-off.
constraints: Increased quality content of the app must justify a price increase.
Price increases must be communicated transparently and directly.
